page.overview:
Who is Barich Fendsor?

Barich Fendsor, also known as Balk Fenzol, is a servant of the Church of Glabados and a minor antagonist in Final Fantasy Tactics. Like Mustadio Bunansa, he is a machinist, specializing in wielding a gun.

Barich was a born a commoner who became a machinist in the Clockwork City of Goug before joining the Knights Templar order. Despite joining an order of knights, he retained his preference for guns instead of the sword. Because Barich had witnessed firsthand how ordinary people suffered and succumbed to the poverty that plagued the country since the Fifty Years' War, he joined a movement against the aristocracy when young, for which he ended up on a blacklist kept by the templarate.

Throughout his service to the Church of Glabados, Barich was infamous for his wild temper and lack of decorum, traits unbecoming of a Knight Templar, which led to him being even more ostracized among them. During this period, Barich grew close to the leader of the Templars, Folmarv Tengille, and began to obey him directly after realizing that he could be given a position of power greater than the one he currently held, despite being fully aware that he was merely being used. It was because of this relationship with Folmarv that Barich knew his sons, Meliadoul and Isilud, although unlike the respect he had for their father, he held them in low esteem, seeing them only as mere obedient children.

During the climax of the War of the Lions, Barich fought Ramza Beoulve in the Beddha Sandwaste in chapter 4, "In the Name of Love", after spreading mossfungus poison throughout the Order of the Northern Sky ranks during the battle of Fort Besselat as part of a nefarious plan orchestrated by the Church. By weakening the Northern Sky, the Order of the Southern Sky would attack in full, leaving Duke Goltanna exposed, allowing both dukes to be killed. During this fight, Barich hurled a bomb of poison at Ramza's company before attacking him with his men. However, even with this advantage, they ended up being defeated and killed, although, ultimately, Barich's group succeeded in fulfilling their roles that contributed to the downfall of Larg and Goltanna.
